Method of Attack: DNS hijack to redirect visitors to attacker-controlled site
Distribution of malware via fake desktop application download
Malware extracts embedded base64 encoded file to %AppData%\svchost.exe and executes it
Creates autostart registry entry named Java to launch malware on login
Attack Vector: DNS hijack via compromised Cloudflare account
Indicators of Compromise: Registry entry HKEY_CURRENT_USER\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run with value named Java
